    • changeColor

      public void changeColor(String newColor)
      Change the shape's color.
      Parameters:
      color - the new color. Valid colors are "red", "yellow", "blue", "green", "black", "white", "magenta", "orange", "pink", "cyan", "gray", "lightGray", "darkGray", "brown" and "maroon".
